description.text: This programe enrolls high school graustes of age from 18 to 30. The mandatory (compulsive) courses of the undergraduate program of Chinese language for foreign student are basic Chinese, mid-level Chinese, advanced Chinese, oral Chinese, listening Chinese, reading comprehension, newspaper and journal reading, linstening comprehension for news, business Chinese, and Chinese-foreign Lanuage translation. In ddition there are more than a dosen optional (elective) courses, incluing coputer-based Chinese editing. After 4 years studies, a student will receive a graduate diploma if he/she has eaened the required course crdits. The student may be conferred upon a degree of Bechalor of Art if he / she passes succesfully the degree theses defence.

duration.text: The Art Design at Guangxi University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: 1.Observe the laws and decrees of China and the regulations of University, and respect the folkways and customs of Chinese. 2.Be in good health. 3.Hold a senior high school graduation certificate 4.Applicants have Chinese proficiency of HSK grade 3 or above.
